name: Seed-source bottleneck certificate
summary: Checks whether your seed or seedling supply network can actually meet planting demand, and where the bottleneck is.

reconciliation.note: The package's Lean status in the canon catalog is 'working' (not spine-admitted); the product warrant was admitted but the canon classification must be reconciled before admission as a function.

inputs.name: demands
inputs.help: Demand at each planting site, as a list.

inputs.name: supplies
inputs.help: Available supply at each source, as a list.

inputs.name: edges
inputs.help: Which source can serve which site, as [source, site] pairs.

hypotheses.statement: Every restoration site demands a positive amount.
hypotheses.check: len(demands) >= 1 and all(x > 0 for x in demands)

hypotheses.statement: Every seed source supplies a non-negative amount.
hypotheses.check: len(supplies) >= 1 and all(x >= 0 for x in supplies)

hypotheses.statement: Every eligibility edge names an existing source and site.
hypotheses.check: all(0 <= e[0] < len(supplies) and 0 <= e[1] < len(demands) for e in edges)

expected_outputs.scope: continuous one-period frozen binary-eligibility supply network

scope: Continuous one-period frozen binary-eligibility network; no field establishment, legality, procurement, or cost claim.
boundary: Model outputs do not establish field suitability, seed availability, land rights, permits, or ecological success. The result is conditional on the supplied inputs; it does not establish empirical validity, Viridis review, certification, a credit, or a registry determination.
